long_context.primary_endpoint: intact/full/8192 F1; equal en/zh and position weighting
long_context.note: Primary means use each language-position cell's matched groups, then equal-weight cells. Bootstrap resamples each language's source-group union once and shares draws across positions and variants. Complete-case means use only groups present at all three positions as sensitivity. Evidence-deleted is original-answer reproduction, not refusal accuracy; conditions are kept separate.

encoder_cost.steady_state_memory_peak_scope: max across all measured rounds in each cell

protocol.timing_scope_cuda_event: NextBert.encode only; excludes MLM head and tokenization
protocol.timing_scope_wall: prepared CPU token tensor to GPU copy, attention-mask construction, and NextBert.encode; excludes tokenization and MLM head

notes: Bilingual aggregates weight en and zh equally; reported task point estimates are recomputed from the saved per-example outputs.

XNLI bootstrap synchronously resamples shared English-premise clusters across EN/ZH; source check: {"rows_per_language":{"en":5010,"zh":5010},"aligned_terminal_indices":5010,"label_mismatches":0,"english_premise_clusters":1670,"premise_groups_repeated_across_source_indices":1670,"maximum_source_indices_per_premise":3,"resampling_unit":"english_premise_cluster_shared_across_aligned_en_zh_ids"}.
Retrieval retains saved point estimates and per-language counts; the archive's combined retrieval JSON omits query_predictions, so paired query bootstrap CIs are unavailable.
BM25 per-query scores are recomputed on the saved fixed top-20 candidate order; test point estimates are checked against bm25_baseline.json.
Retrieval query-level bootstrap is unavailable when saved combined outputs omit per-query predictions.
Quality deltas are descriptive paired bootstrap intervals; they are not additional training seeds or a scalar quality score.
